text: Enforced a core-only 1.0 matrix in build.sbt: only ravel-core JVM/Scala.js publish, while laws/packed/stencil set publish / skip true. Added verifyCoreReleaseMatrix and wired it into artifact and snapshot paths; a negative sbt session fails specifically when lawsJVM is made publishable. verifyPublishArtifacts and shell inspection pass for only core coordinates; publishLocalSnapshot emitted only ravel-core_3 and ravel-core_sjs1_3; docsCheck passed; release contract, candidate notes, README, guide, evidence, and workflow now state the same boundary.
